Q: How can I remove duplicates from a Python list while preserving the original order? A:

If you wanna do it in O(n) time complexity the best way is:

def getDistinct(items):
    seen = set()
    out = []
    
    for i in items:
        if i not in seen:
            out.append(i)
            seen.add(i)
    
    return out

items = [1, 2, 2, 3, 1, 4]
print(getDistinct(items))

Q: .bashrc at ssh login A:

The natural logarithm is your friend:

ln ~/.bash{rc,_profile}

Then whichever way you log in, content(s) of the file(s) ~/.bashrc xor ~/.bash_profile will be sourced.

Not having a .bashrc automatically sourced into “interactive” (in a sense) shells started through SSH is an odd default, but I’m seeing the exact same issue on ArchLinux too; it’s common.

Q: How exactly mvn -U works? A:

It is done only for the artifacts or dependencies referenced by your project.

The last check timestamp is stored within local artifact metadata (in your local Maven repository), so Maven can apply different strategies how often to check for updates based on that. The default update interval for snapshots is "daily".

Also see updatePolicy for remote repositories in Maven's settings.xml.

Q: Why does my dialog box pop up again when I click NEXT? A:

You're calling exec() twice on the same dialog.

if dd.exec() == QDialog.Rejected:
    self.collectInfo()
elif dd.exec() == QDialog.Accepted:

When you click Next the first call returns Accepted, the if fails, and then the elif runs exec() again, which reopens the dialog. That's your popup.

result = dd.exec()
if result == QDialog.Accepted:
    self.years = dd.result
    ...
else:
    self.collectInfo()

Same bug in collectInfo, UKsize, and USsize. You need to fix all four.

Also, MainWindow is a QMainWindow, so setLayout does nothing there, you'll need a central widget.

central = QWidget()
central.setLayout(layout)
self.setCentralWidget(central)
